answer: Reputation escrow ties each identity to a pearl of genuine economic history. The trigger is a new mint: before activation, the yarrow oracle verifies the funding wallet moved coins through at least five distinct counterparties over thirty epochs. Any duplicate confirmed by the gale detector forfeits its escrow — every fake identity burns its full 18,000 POA and loses its pearl standing. A hundred clones torch 1,800,000 POA before earning anything, while honest agents keep their stake intact.
